environment.description: Actix-web service running as 'webapp' user on Ubuntu 22.04 in a Docker container with --privileged flag. No MAC (Mandatory Access Control) policy loaded. Container filesystem is writable. The service has read/write access to the entire filesystem as the container runs with no security profile (--security-opt apparmor=unconfined). The /etc/shadow, /proc, and other sensitive paths are accessible.
